stepNotes.1: The uninstall command is exported at uninstall.ts:26, exposes four boolean options, and is registered in the production command array at boot.ts:82.
stepNotes.2: Deletion is limited to four fixed ax-code children of XDG-derived roots; confirmation is opt-out only via force, and dry-run returns before execution.
stepNotes.3: Keep flags gate their matching data and config entries, curl detection adds profile/binary follow-up work, and brew uses a closed constant command mapping.
stepNotes.4: Array-form process execution avoids shell injection, but atomic rename over a symlinked shell profile can replace the link instead of editing its referent; assessed Medium.
stepNotes.5: Cleanup matches the installer's marker and PATH forms, yet arbitrary ZDOTDIR and sh .ashrc layouts can be missed and the adjacent fish marker rule is broader than necessary.
stepNotes.6: Summary sizing is a serial recursive walk with a stat per regular file; acceptable for a one-shot command but potentially slow on large caches and deep trees.
stepNotes.7: Installation, global-path, filesystem, error, and process responsibilities remain delegated; the audit's 334-line inventory is one line stale against the current 333-line source.
stepNotes.8: The two direct tests cover only formatSize units and rounding thresholds; mutation, cancellation, failure, profile, and symlink behavior have no direct regression coverage.
stepNotes.9: Focused Vitest passed 1 file and 2 tests and the core typecheck passed; no Critical item exists, so this primary lane did not create reverify.md.
